description: This file defines the behavior and UI interactions of the Drupal administration toolbar, including toolbar state management, media query responsiveness, and dynamic rendering of toolbar components.

classes.name: Drupal.toolbar.ToolbarModel
classes.description: Backbone model representing the toolbar's state, including active tab, orientation, and other UI flags.

classes.name: Drupal.toolbar.ToolbarVisualView
classes.description: View responsible for rendering the visual aspects of the toolbar.

classes.name: Drupal.toolbar.ToolbarAuralView
classes.description: View responsible for accessibility features of the toolbar.

classes.name: Drupal.toolbar.BodyVisualView
classes.description: View managing the visual layout of the toolbar's body.

classes.name: Drupal.toolbar.MenuModel
classes.description: Model for managing toolbar menu subtrees.

classes.name: Drupal.toolbar.MenuVisualView
classes.description: View for rendering the toolbar menu.

methods.name: mediaQueryChangeHandler
methods.description: Handles changes in media query states to update toolbar orientation, fixed state, and toggle visibility.
